name: mcp-commander-quoting
description: Cost estimation and quoting cartridge. Provides tools for material cost calculation, machining time estimation, and quote generation for manufactured parts.

tools.name: estimate_material_cost
tools.description: Calculate material cost based on part volume and material properties

tools.name: estimate_machining_time
tools.description: Estimate CNC machining time based on part complexity and volume

tools.name: generate_quote
tools.description: Generate a manufacturing cost quote with material, labor, and overhead breakdown

tools.name: compare_processes
tools.description: Compare cost of different manufacturing processes (CNC, 3DP, casting, sheet metal)

tools.name: calculate_lead_time
tools.description: Estimate manufacturing lead time based on part complexity and process

tools.name: lookup_machinability
tools.description: Look up machinability ratings and recommended speeds/feeds for a material
